jobs:

    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Verify the exact reviewed publisher bytes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' 'd3cbf3ef67e5020483dcb28fb57ae58d97bc2f1389d8ca51f79b8bf8a025b7c6  publication-transfer/review-db841575/publish_bundle.py' | sha256sum --check --strict

        run: python3 publication-transfer/review-db841575/publish_bundle.py --publish
